questions.question:
Study the following bar graph that shows the number of students enrolled for different courses in institutes A and B during 5 years, and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81931cc6fc96f52f0c901e21aa94a93e2c0ce0613d9771506c70248ea7d7603b.png] 

What is the ratio of the total numbers of students enrolled in A during 2017 and 2018 to that of students enrolled in B during 2014 and 2015?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Total number of students enrolled in A during 2017 and 2018 = 250 + 260

⇒ 510

Total number of students enrolled in B during 2014 and 2015 = 225 + 360

⇒ 585

Ratio = 510 : 585

⇒ 34 : 39

**∴ Required answer is 34 : 39**

questions.question: If x is subtracted from each of 52, 47, 20 and 19, the number so obtained in this order are in proportion. What is the mean proportional between (x + 13) and (x - 8)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For numbers a, b, c, d to be in proportion when x is subtracted: x = (ad − bc) ÷ ((a + d) − (b + c))

Here, a = 52, b = 47, c = 20, d = 19

x = (52 × 19 − 47 × 20) ÷ ((52 + 19) − (47 + 20)) = (988 − 940) ÷ (71 − 67) = 48 ÷ 4 = 12

Mean proportional between (x + 13) and (x − 8) = √((12 + 13) × (12 − 8)) = √(25 × 4) = √100 = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers: 52, 47, 20, 19

When x is subtracted from each, they become proportional.

**Formula Used:**

If a, b, c, and d are in proportion, then a ÷ b = c ÷ d.

Mean proportional between two numbers p and q = √(p × q)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4d3826141a9fdd439c4410d6fbe8fa43baf6014e65dc5053757c47b7ae57d90.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ (52 − x) : (47 − x) :: (20 − x) : (19 − x)

⇒ (52 − x) ÷ (47 − x) = (20 − x) ÷ (19 − x)

⇒ (52 − x)(19 − x) = (20 − x)(47 − x)

⇒ 988 − 52x − 19x + x² = 940 − 20x − 47x + x²

⇒ 988 − 71x = 940 − 67x

⇒ 71x − 67x = 988 − 940

⇒ 4x = 48

⇒ x = 12

Now, finding the given terms to calculate the mean proportional:

⇒ First term = (x + 13) = 12 + 13 = 25

⇒ Second term = (x − 8) = 12 − 8 = 4

⇒ Mean proportional = √(25 × 4) = √100 = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is given by √(a × b). It represents the value x such that a : x :: x : b.

Third Proportional

If a, b, and c are in continued proportion (a : b :: b : c), then c is the third proportional to a and b. Formula: c = b² ÷ a.

Fourth Proportional

For numbers a, b, and c, the fourth proportional is x such that a : b :: c : x. Formula: x = (b × c) ÷ a.

Componendo and Dividendo

If a ÷ b = c ÷ d, then applying Componendo and Dividendo gives (a + b) ÷ (a − b) = (c + d) ÷ (c − d). This rule is widely used to simplify complex ratios.

questions.question: The marked price of an article is ₹400. After allowing a discount of 20% on the marked price, a shopkeeper makes a profit of ₹48. His gain percentage is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

M.P = Rs. 400 and discount = 20%

**Concept used:**

Gain% = [(S.P. – C.P)/C.P] ×100

S.P = [(100 - D%)/M.P] × 100

Profit = S.P - C.P

Where C.P = Cost Price, S.P = Selling Price, M.P = Marked Price, D% = Discount %

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

S.P = [(100 - D%)/M.P] × 100

S.P = M.P. × 80/100

⇒ 400 × 80/100

⇒ Rs. 320

C.P. = S.P. – Profit

⇒ 320 - 48

⇒ Rs. 272

Gain percentage = (48/272) × 100 = 17(11)/(17)%

**∴ Required gain percentage is 17(11)/(17)%**

questions.question: 'A' is 3 times as good a workman as 'B' and therefore is able to complete a job in 36 days less than 'B'. In how many days will they finish it working together?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A' is 3 times as good a workman as 'B' and therefore is able to complete a job in 36 days less than 'B'

**Concept used:**

Total work = LCM of time taken by the workers

Efficiency of work is inversely proportional to the time

**Calculation:**

Ratio of efficiency of A and B = 3 : 1

So,

Ratio of time taken by A and B = 1 : 3

Let time taken by A and B be x days and 3x days

According to the question,

3x - x = 36 days

⇒ 2x = 36

⇒ x = 18

So,

A = 18 days

B = 54 days

Now,

Total work = 54 units

So, time taken by them = 54/4 = 13(1)/(2)days

**∴ Required time is 13(1)/(2)days**

questions.question: The median of a set of 11 distinct observations is 17.5. If each of the largest 5 observations of the set is increased by 3, then the median of the new set:

options.text: is three times of the original number
remains the same as that of the original set

questions.solution:
**Given:**

The median of the set of 11 distinct observations is 17.5.

**Concept used:**

Median of set of n observation = [(n + 1)/2]th observation

**Calculation:**

[(n + 1)/2]th observation observation = 6th observation

∵ The 6th observation is not changed.

**∴ The median of the new set remains the same.**

questions.question: A boy walked along two adjacent sides of a rectangular field. If he had walked along the diagonal, then he would have saved a distance equal to one-fourth of the larger side. The ratio of the larger to the smaller side is:
questions.solution:
**Formula used:**

Base² + Perpendicular² = Hypotenuse²

**Calculation:**

Let the Length, breadth, and diagonal of the rectangular field be l, b, and d

Letting that l > b

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75fbae8affddc722f3610688fbbc495d6f0c3fdbd389ed0755496f96d266cee8.png] 

In the right-angle triangle ABC.

By using Pythagoras's Theorem we have:

l² + b² = d² ......(1)

l + b - d = 1/4 × l

⇒ l + b - l/4 = d

⇒ 3l/4 + b = d .....(2)

Putting the value of d in equation (1), we get:

l² + b² = (3l/4 + b)²

⇒ l2 + b2 = 9l²/16 + b² + 2 × 3l/4 × b

⇒ l² - 9l²/16 = 3lb/2

⇒ 7l/8 = 3b

⇒ l/b = 3 × 8/7

⇒ l/b = 24/7 

**∴ The ratio of the larger to the smaller side is 24 : 7**

questions.question: If 4 men can reap a field in 5 days working 9 hours a day, in how many days can 10 men reap the same field working 6 hours a day?
questions.solution:
**​****Given:** 

4 men can reap a field in 5 days working 9 hours a day 

**Formula used:** 

(M₁ × D₁ × H₁)/W₁ = (M₂ × D₂ × H₂)/W₂ 

**Calculation:** 

(4 × 5 × 9)/1 = (10 × D₂ × 6)/1 

⇒ D2 = (4 × 5 × 9)/(10 × 6) 

⇒ D2 = 3 

**∴ The required number of days are 3.**

questions.question: Sita and Geeta start at the same time to ride from place A to place B, which is 90 km away from A. Sita travels 3 km per hour slower than Geeta. Geeta reaches place B and at once turns back meeting Sita 15 km from place B. Sita's speed (in km/h) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance between place A and B = 90 km

Speed of Sita = Speed of Geeta - 3 km/h

**Formula used:**

Ratio of distance = Ratio of speed (When the time is equal)

**Calculation:**

Distance travelled by Sita = 75 km

Distance travelled by Geeta = 90 + 15 = 105 km

Ratio of Distance in a certain time travelled by Sita and Geeta is equal to the ratio of the speed = 75 : 105

⇒ 5 : 7

⇒ 7 - 5 = 2 units = 3 km/h

⇒ 1 unit = 1.5 km/h

⇒ 5 = 5 × 1.5 = 7.5 km/h

**∴ The speed of Sita is 7.5 km/h.**

questions.question: A rectangular room has an area of 60 m² and perimeter of 34 m. The length of the diagonal of the rectangular room is same as the side of a square. The area of the square (in m²) is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

L + B = Perimeter ÷ 2 = 34 ÷ 2 = 17 m

Area of Rectangle = L × B = 60 m²

Diagonal of Rectangle (D) = √(L² + B²)

Area of Square = D² = L² + B² = (L + B)² − 2 × L × B

Area = 17² − 2 × 60 = 289 − 120 = 169 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 169 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Area of rectangular room = 60 m²

Perimeter of rectangular room = 34 m

Side of the square = Diagonal of the rectangular room

**Formula Used:**

Perimeter of rectangle = 2 × (L + B)

Area of rectangle = L × B

Diagonal of rectangle = √(L² + B²)

Area of square = (Side)²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f3cdee51a22204fe372c796eae14c79ecd94d95d865c583824da68d5251847a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 2 × (L + B) = 34

⇒ L + B = 17

⇒ L × B = 60

⇒ Diagonal of rectangle = √(L² + B²)

⇒ Side of square = √(L² + B²)

⇒ Area of square = L² + B²

⇒ We know that (L + B)² = L² + B² + 2 × L × B

⇒ L² + B² = 17² − 2 × 60

⇒ Area of square = 289 − 120 = 169 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 169 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Identities

The expansion formula (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2 × a × b is heavily utilized in geometry to directly deduce sum of squares or diagonals without having to find the precise values of the individual side lengths.

Properties of a Rectangle

Opposite sides are parallel and strictly equal in length. All interior angles are equal to 90°, and diagonals are equal in length and bisect each other.

Properties of a Square

All four sides are equal, making the area simply square of its side. Both diagonals are precisely equal, intersect perpendicularly at 90°, and have a total length of a√2.

questions.question: A person borrows ₹ 75,000 for 3 years at 5% simple interest. He lends it to B at 7% for 3 years. What is his gain (in ₹)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net interest rate gain per year = 7% − 5% = 2%

Total gain percentage over 3 years = 2% × 3 = 6%

Gain amount = 6% of Principal (₹75,000)

⇒ Gain = 75,000 × (6 ÷ 100) = ₹4,500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4,500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹75,000

Time (T) = 3 years

Rate of borrowing (R₁) = 5% per annum

Rate of lending (R₂) = 7% per annum

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Gain = SI Received − SI Paid

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0c3707c4f8189066c5e86346830e97cc05ea02e7502f431b4b1222a7e19a131.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Interest paid = (75,000 × 5 × 3) ÷ 100

⇒ Interest paid = 750 × 15 = ₹11,250

⇒ Interest received = (75,000 × 7 × 3) ÷ 100

⇒ Interest received = 750 × 21 = ₹15,750

⇒ Total gain = 15,750 − 11,250 = ₹4,500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4,500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest (SI)

Interest is calculated only on the principal amount throughout the tenure. Formula: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Compound Interest (CI)

Interest is calculated on the principal plus any previously accumulated interest. Amount = P × (1 + R/100)T.

Difference Between CI and SI

For 2 years, Difference = P × (R/100)². For 3 years, Difference = P × (R/100)² × (3 + R/100).

questions.question: A train takes 1 hour 20 minutes to travel between two stations, P and Q. If it travels at (5)/(6) of its usual speed, how long will it take to travel between P and Q?
questions.solution:

Distance/Speed = Time

Time = 1/speed

**Calculation:**

Let the usual speed be 6 units/h

⇒ Reduced speed = 6 × 5/6 = 5 units/h

Total distance covered by the train with usual speed = 4/3 × 6 = 8 units [1 hour 20 minutes = 4/3 hours]

So,

With reduced speed

⇒ 8/5 hours

⇒ 60 × 8/5 = 96 minutes or 1 hour 36 minutes

**∴ Time taken to travel from P to Q with reduced speed is 1 hour 36 minutes.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** s₁/s₂ = t₂/t₁

s₁ = 6 units, and s₂ = 5 units

t₁ = 4/3 hours

⇒ 6/5 = t₂/4/3

⇒ 8/5 hours = 1 + 3/5 hours 

⇒ 1 hour + 3/5 × 60 minutes 

⇒ 1 hour 36 minutes

questions.question: A certain sum amounts to ₹ 29,282 in 4 years at 10% p.a. when the interest is compounded yearly. What is the simple interest (in ₹) on the same sum for 5 years at the same rate?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Rate of interest = 10%

Amount = Rs. 29282

Time for C.I = 4 years

Time for S.I = 5 years

**Concept used:**

A = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

Where, A = Amount P = Principal r = rate of interest n = time period in years

S.I. = PRT/100

**Calculation:**

29282 = P(1 + 10/100)⁴

⇒ 29282 = P(11/10)⁴

⇒ P = 29282 × 10/11 × 10/11 × 10/11 × 10/11

⇒ P = Rs. 20000

S.I. = (20000 × 10 × 5)/100

⇒ S.I. = Rs. 10000

**∴ Required simple interest is Rs. 10000**

questions.question: A man bought two articles for ₹ 3,000 each. He sold one article at 10% profit and the other at 5% loss. What is the total profit or loss percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price of two articles = Rs.3000 each

Profit on one article = 10%

Loss on the other article = 5%

**Formulas used:**

Selling Price = Cost Price × (100 + Profit)/100%

Profit = Selling Price - Cost Price

Profit percent = Profit/Cost Price × 100

**Calculation:**

Total Cost Price of both articles = Rs.3000 + Rs.3000 = Rs.6000 

Selling Price of one article at 10% profit = 3000 × 110/100 = Rs.3300

Selling Price of another article at 5% loss = 3000 × 95/100 = Rs.2850

Total Selling Price of both articles = 3300 + 2850 = Rs.6150

Profit on both articles = Rs.6150 - Rs.6000 = 150

Profit Percent on both articles = 150/6000 × 100 

⇒ 2.5%

**∴ The total profit percentage is 2.5**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** If the cost price of two articles is the same.

Profit/Loss % = (+10 - 5)/2 = 2.5%

Positive sign indicates profit and negative sign indicates loss.
